{"id":"JMAP-cayv.2","title":"jmap-types: i18n module (capability, LanguageTag, Localizations, RFC 4647 Lookup, check/prune helpers, Localizable trait)","description":"jmap-types: new `i18n` module (pure, no async):
- JMAP_I18N_URI = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:i18n"
- I18nCapability {} and I18nAccountCapability { preferred_languages: Option<Vec<LanguageTag>> }
- LanguageTag: RFC 5646 well-formed, case-insensitive Eq/Hash, `canonical()` per 5646 2.1.1
- LanguageRange: RFC 4647 2.1, including "*"
- Localizations: map from LanguageTag to the existing jmap_types::PatchObject (patch.rs:81)

Pure functions:
- `lookup(ranges, available_keys, locale) -> Option<&LanguageTag>`: RFC 4647 3.4 Lookup. It truncates subtags and never widens ("de" does not match "de-CH"). "*" is skipped when other ranges follow and selects the default when it is last. With no match, it returns `locale`.
- `localized_view(obj: &mut Map, localizations, chosen)`: applies the chosen PatchObject and sets `locale`; `localizations` is kept (the draft dropped the strip step).
- `check_localizations(locale, localizations, &[LocalizableProperty{name, nullable}]) -> Result<(), SetError invalidProperties naming "localizations">`. Rules:
  - keys are language tags
  - keys are unique ignoring case, and no key equals `locale`
  - patch keys are localizable properties only
  - values have the property's type
  - null only for nullable properties
- `prune_stale(localizations, changed_base_props, touched)`: for each language whose PatchObject the update did not set (not `localizations` as a whole, not `localizations/<tag>`, not `localizations/<tag>/<prop>`), remove the changed props and drop empty patches. Returns whether anything changed, so the caller echoes `localizations` in `updated`.
- Trait `Localizable { const LOCALIZABLE: &'static [LocalizableProperty]; }`.

Tests:
- RFC 4647 examples; "de" vs "de-CH"; "*" first, middle and last; locale null
- case-colliding keys; key == locale; null on non-nullable
- pruning with each kind of touched path
